components.name: site-header
components.behaviors: Contains site title, skip link, and optional search form. Fixed position at top of page.
components.keyboardExpectations: Skip link receives focus first and is visible on focus; search form inputs are tabbable.

components.name: primary-nav
components.behaviors: Horizontal list of links to major sections and pages; indicates current page with aria-current.
components.keyboardExpectations: Each link is focusable in tab order; Enter activates navigation.

components.name: site-footer
components.behaviors: Contains copyright, fictional address, and placeholder policy links.

components.name: breadcrumb
components.behaviors: Shows hierarchical path from homepage to current page.

components.name: article-card
components.behaviors: Displays a preview of an article with image, title, timestamp, summary, and read‑more link.
components.keyboardExpectations: Read‑more link is focusable; Enter activates.

components.name: latest-tabs
components.behaviors: Two tabs (Latest / Most Read) that toggle visibility of associated article lists.
components.keyboardExpectations: Each tab button is focusable; Space or Enter activates; arrow keys move between tabs.

components.name: newsletter-signup
components.behaviors: Email input with submit button; validates format and shows inline success/error messages.
components.keyboardExpectations: Input and button are tabbable; Enter on button submits; focus moves to message after submit.

components.name: subscription-form
components.behaviors: Plan selection, name and email fields, submit button; shows modal confirmation on submit.
components.keyboardExpectations: All fields and button are tabbable; Enter on button submits; focus moves to modal close button.

components.name: search-form
components.behaviors: Site‑wide search; filters inline article data and displays results in a live region.
components.keyboardExpectations: Input and button are tabbable; Enter submits; results are announced via live region.

components.name: staff-card
components.behaviors: Displays staff member placeholder photo, name, role, and short bio.
components.keyboardExpectations: None beyond standard tab order; content is static.

components.name: rss-item
components.behaviors: Shows RSS feed title, URL, description, and subscribe link.
components.keyboardExpectations: Subscribe link is focusable; Enter activates (simulated).

components.name: faq-item
components.behaviors: Presents a question and its answer.

components.name: contact-info
components.behaviors: Provides contact email addresses and mailing address.
components.keyboardExpectations: Email links are focusable; Enter activates mailto.

components.name: modal
components.behaviors: Dialog that appears after subscription submission, showing fictional confirmation.
components.keyboardExpectations: Focus traps inside modal on open; close button is focusable; Escape closes and returns focus to trigger.
